shared_until_stopped.description: Name of the session length that has no timer and ends only when the user ends it.

shared_preset_short.description: Name of the shortest duration preset, read after the minutes: '25 short'. Lower case.

shared_preset_focus.description: Name of the middle duration preset, read after the minutes: '50 focus'. Lower case.

shared_preset_deep_work.description: Name of the longest duration preset, read after the minutes: '90 deep work'. Lower case.

shared_deep_work_note.message: A preference, not science: one long uninterrupted block, with no automatic breaks.
shared_deep_work_note.description: Hover explanation of the deep work duration preset.

shared_timed_hint_cycles.message: $MINUTES$ min total, with $FOCUS$ min focus blocks
shared_timed_hint_cycles.description: Hint under the duration presets when focus and break cycles interrupt the session.

shared_timed_hint_plain.description: Hint under the duration presets when nothing interrupts the session.

shared_start_until_stopped.description: Start button of a Flexible session that runs until the user ends it.

shared_lock_until_manual_unlock.description: Start button of a Friction session that ends only through its deliberation gate.

shared_until_stopped_disclosure.message: Until stopped sessions keep Flexible or Friction and cannot use focus and break cycles.
shared_until_stopped_disclosure.description: Disclosure under the duration control while Until stopped is selected.

shared_hard_unavailable_reason.message: Hard lock is not available for Until stopped: with no timer and no manual end, the session could never end.
shared_hard_unavailable_reason.description: Why the Hard lock strictness is disabled while Until stopped is selected.

shared_end_session.description: Button that ends a running Flexible session.

shared_unlock.description: Button that confirms the deliberation gate and ends a Friction session.

shared_gate_wait_none.description: The deliberation wait as a phrase when the gate has no delay. Used inside a sentence.

shared_gate_wait.description: The deliberation wait as a phrase, used inside a sentence.

shared_gate_requirement_typed.description: What the deliberation gate demands when it also asks for a typed phrase. WAIT is the wait phrase, for example 'a 10-second wait'.

shared_until_stopped_hint_flexible.message: Runs until you end it with $LABEL$. Cycles off.
shared_until_stopped_hint_flexible.description: Hint under the duration control for a Flexible until-stopped session. LABEL is the End session button label.

shared_until_stopped_hint_friction.message: Runs until you unlock it: $REQUIREMENT$, then $LABEL$. Cycles off.
shared_until_stopped_hint_friction.description: Hint under the duration control for a Friction until-stopped session. REQUIREMENT is what the gate demands, LABEL is the Unlock button label.

REQUIREMENT.example: a 10-second wait and a typed sentence

shared_forced_cycles_label.description: Accessible name of the disabled focus and break cycle group. Heard by screen readers only.

shared_mode_blacklist.description: Blocking mode where the chosen categories and rules are blocked and other sites stay available.

shared_mode_whitelist.description: Blocking mode where only the chosen sites stay available and everything else is blocked.

shared_focus_time_label.description: Label of the clock showing wall-clock time spent in the focus phase.

shared_clock_focus_phase.description: Name of the clock counting the current focus block. Lower case, read after a time.

shared_clock_total_session.description: Name of the clock counting the whole session. Lower case, read after a time.

shared_clock_pause.description: Name of the clock counting a pause. Lower case, read after a time.

shared_clock_break.description: Name of the clock counting a break between focus blocks. Lower case, read after a time.

shared_badge_indefinite.description: Toolbar badge text while a session runs with no end time. At most four characters.

shared_popup_starting.message: Focus Lock is starting. Applying your selected rules.
shared_popup_starting.description: Popup status while the session is starting. Focus Lock is the product name, keep untranslated.

shared_popup_closure_cleanup.description: Popup and settings status after a session ended, while cleanup finishes.

shared_popup_transition_cleanup.message: Focus Lock could not start. Finishing browser cleanup.
shared_popup_transition_cleanup.description: Popup status after a failed start, while cleanup finishes.

shared_popup_transition_error.message: Focus Lock could not clean up an incomplete start.
shared_popup_transition_error.description: Popup error when cleanup after a failed start did not finish.

shared_popup_closure_error.message: Focus Lock could not finish browser cleanup.
shared_popup_closure_error.description: Popup error when cleanup after a session did not finish.

shared_retry_cleanup.description: Button that runs the failed browser cleanup again.

shared_end_failed.message: Could not end session. Try again.
shared_end_failed.description: Error shown when ending the session failed.

shared_retry_failed.message: Could not retry cleanup. Try again.
shared_retry_failed.description: Error shown when retrying cleanup failed.

shared_action_failed.message: Could not request that action. Try again.
shared_action_failed.description: Error shown when a request to the extension worker failed.

shared_return_to_work_failed.message: Could not return to work. Try again.
shared_return_to_work_failed.description: Error shown when switching back to the work tab failed.

shared_data_clear_pending.message: Deleting Focus Lock data. Finishing cleanup.
shared_data_clear_pending.description: Status while the extension deletes its stored data.

shared_data_clear_error.message: Could not delete data. Try again.
shared_data_clear_error.description: Error shown when deleting stored data failed.

shared_schedule_window_label.description: Session length option that runs until the scheduled window closes.

shared_schedule_until_stopped.message: Starts on schedule and runs until you stop it: End session for Flexible, Unlock through the deliberation gate for Friction. Cycles off.
shared_schedule_until_stopped.description: Schedule editor explanation of an until-stopped scheduled session. End session and Unlock are button labels.

shared_schedule_started_title.description: Notification title when a scheduled session starts.

shared_schedule_until_stopped_body.description: Notification body for a scheduled session with no end time.

shared_settings_indefinite.message: Until stopped session active. Use the toolbar popup to view or end it.
shared_settings_indefinite.description: Settings page status while an until-stopped session runs.

shared_settings_starting.message: Focus Lock is starting. Checking website access and applying your rules.
shared_settings_starting.description: Settings page status while a session is starting.

shared_settings_error.message: Focus Lock could not finish browser cleanup. Open the popup and retry.
shared_settings_error.description: Settings page error when cleanup did not finish.

shared_settings_session_disclosure.message: The toolbar popup owns session controls. Your changes reach the running session as you make them, except a hard lock, which holds anything that unblocks until it ends.
shared_settings_session_disclosure.description: Settings page note explaining that a running session cannot be edited here.

shared_settings_timed.message: Timed session active until $TIME$. It ends automatically. Use the toolbar popup for live status.
shared_settings_timed.description: Settings page status for a running timed session. TIME is a local clock time.

shared_outcome_timer_completed.description: Session log outcome: the session ran to the end of its timer.

shared_outcome_manual_completed.description: Session log outcome: the user ended the session after it had finished its work.

shared_outcome_manual_canceled.description: Session log outcome: the user ended the session before its planned end.

shared_outcome_website_access_lost.description: Session log outcome: the browser withdrew the site access permission.

shared_outcome_content_registration_fail.description: Session log outcome: the blocking script could not be registered.

shared_outcome_alarm_failed.description: Session log outcome: the session timer could not be created.

shared_outcome_tab_enforcement_failed.description: Session log outcome: blocking could not be applied to open pages.

shared_outcome_invalid_active_state.description: Session log outcome: the stored session state could not be restored.

shared_duration_hours_minutes.description: A duration of an hour or more, in compact unit abbreviations. MINUTES is zero padded.

shared_duration_minutes.description: A duration under an hour, in a compact unit abbreviation.

shared_minutes_one.description: A whole number of minutes, abbreviated. Singular form.

shared_minutes_other.description: A whole number of minutes, abbreviated. Plural form.

shared_updating_session.description: Placeholder shown while the session state is being recalculated.

shared_less_than_a_minute.description: Remaining time when under one minute is left.

shared_focus_remaining_break.description: Time left in the current focus block before a break. DURATION is a time such as '5 min'.

shared_focus_remaining_session.description: Time left in the session. DURATION is a time such as '5 min'.

shared_cost_exceeds_limit.description: Why a site cannot be unlocked: it costs more than the credit cap allows.

shared_credit_resumes_focus.description: Why credit is not growing: the session is not in a focus phase.

shared_credit_off.description: Why credit is not growing: the setting is disabled.

shared_not_enough_time.message: Not enough time in this focus block
shared_not_enough_time.description: Why a site cannot be unlocked: the focus block ends before enough credit is earned.

shared_ready_in.description: Countdown until enough credit is earned. CLOCK is a time such as '1:30'.

shared_verdict_with_pattern.description: A blocking verdict followed by the rule that matched. PATTERN is a domain or pattern.

shared_verdict_blocked_category.description: The site is blocked because it belongs to a selected category.

shared_verdict_blocked_custom.description: The site is blocked by a rule the user added.

shared_verdict_whitelist_miss.description: The site is blocked because only listed sites are allowed.

shared_verdict_blocked_session.description: The site is blocked, with no more specific reason.

shared_verdict_allow_list.description: The site is available because the user listed it.

shared_verdict_always_allowed.description: The site is never blocked, such as the browser's own pages.

shared_verdict_unlock.description: The site is available because the user spent credit on it.

shared_verdict_excluded.description: The site belongs to a blocked category but the user excluded it.

shared_verdict_no_session.description: Nothing is blocked because no session is running.

shared_verdict_allowed_session.description: The site is available, with no more specific reason.

shared_category_social.description: Name of the blocking category holding social networks.

shared_category_video.description: Name of the blocking category holding video and streaming sites.

shared_category_news.description: Name of the blocking category holding news sites.

shared_category_mail.description: Name of the blocking category holding webmail sites.

shared_category_shopping.description: Name of the blocking category holding shopping sites.

shared_category_gaming.description: Name of the blocking category holding gaming sites.

shared_category_forums.description: Name of the blocking category holding forums and time-sink sites.

shared_synced_settings.description: Item in the list of data synced across browsers: the user's preferences.

shared_synced_lists.description: Item in the list of data synced across browsers.

shared_synced_credit.description: Item in the list of data synced across browsers: earned unlock credit.

shared_synced_streaks.description: Item in the list of data synced across browsers: consecutive focus days.

shared_synced_aggregates.description: Item in the list of data synced across browsers: counts of blocked visits per domain.

shared_local_full_urls.description: Item in the list of data that never leaves the device.

shared_local_intentions.description: Item in the list of data that never leaves the device: what the user wrote they would work on.

shared_local_events.description: Item in the list of data that never leaves the device.

shared_local_runtime.description: Item in the list of data that never leaves the device: the session in progress.

shared_legacy_policy_dropped.message: Some synced data from an older version could not be read and was reset.
shared_legacy_policy_dropped.description: Warning shown when settings from an older release could not be migrated.

shared_all_data_clear_running.message: End the running session before deleting all data.
shared_all_data_clear_running.description: Why the delete-all-data control is disabled while a session runs.

shared_nav_brand.description: Product name in the settings sidebar. Keep untranslated.

shared_nav_product.description: Accessible name of the settings sidebar. Heard by screen readers only.

shared_nav_overview.description: Sidebar link to the statistics page.

shared_nav_settings.description: Sidebar heading above the settings sections.

shared_section_blocking.description: Settings section for categories and rules.

shared_section_schedule.description: Settings section for automatic session start times.

shared_section_behavior.description: Settings section for strictness and cycles.

shared_section_budget.description: Settings section for earned unlock credit.

shared_section_notifications.description: Settings section for sounds and notifications.

shared_section_privacy.description: Settings section for stored data and deletion.

shared_theme_auto.description: Theme that follows the operating system setting.

shared_theme_button.description: Accessible name of the theme button. CURRENT and NEXT are theme names such as Auto, Light, Dark.

shared_theme_error.message: Could not save theme. Reload page and try again.
shared_theme_error.description: Error shown when the theme choice could not be stored.

shared_host_search_label.description: Label and placeholder of the search box over one category's sites. TITLE is a category name.

shared_host_none.description: Status when a site search has no results. TITLE is a category name.

shared_host_partial.message: Showing $SHOWN$ of $MATCHED$ sites. Search to narrow the list.
shared_host_partial.description: Status when only the first page of matching sites is rendered.

shared_host_matched.description: Status when a search narrowed the list of sites.

shared_host_all.description: Status when every site in the category is listed.

shared_end_the_session.description: Label on the confirm button of the gate that ends a session.

shared_overlay_starting_title.description: Heading on the block page while the session starts. Focus Lock is the product name, keep untranslated.

shared_overlay_starting_detail.description: Line under the starting heading on the block page.

shared_overlay_stopped_page.message: This page did not load. It will load by itself when the session ends.
shared_overlay_stopped_page.description: Note on a blocked page whose loading was stopped.

shared_overlay_next_step.description: Heading over the intention the user wrote when starting the session.

shared_overlay_back_to_work.description: Button on the block page that switches to the chosen work tab.

shared_overlay_choose_work_tab.description: Button on the block page shown when no work tab has been chosen yet.

shared_overlay_change_work_tab.description: Button on the block page that picks a different work tab.

shared_overlay_access_summary.message: Need a break or site access?
shared_overlay_access_summary.description: Label of the collapsed drawer holding the break and unlock actions.

shared_overlay_access_note.message: You can step away at any time. Site access uses credit.
shared_overlay_access_note.description: Note inside the access drawer on the block page.

shared_overlay_gate_force_end.description: Button that skips the remaining deliberation wait.

shared_overlay_transport_error.message: Focus Lock could not update this action. Try again.
shared_overlay_transport_error.description: Error on the block page when a request to the extension worker failed.

shared_overlay_bank_amount.description: The earned credit balance on the block page. AMOUNT is a clock value such as 5:00.

shared_overlay_next_step_fallback.description: The intention line on the block page when the session was started without one.

shared_overlay_pause_action.description: Action on the block page that unlocks every site for a while, paying with credit.

shared_overlay_unlock_site_action.description: Action on the block page that unlocks only the blocked site, paying with credit.

shared_overlay_spend_action.description: One spend action with how long it lasts and what it costs. LABEL is the action name, LENGTH and COST are clock values.

shared_overlay_locked_until.description: Status line of a timed session on the block page. TIME is a local clock time.

shared_overlay_gate_said.description: Quotes back the intention the user wrote, on the deliberation gate.

shared_overlay_unlock_host.description: Gate heading for unlocking one site. HOST is a domain, CLOCK is how long the unlock lasts.

shared_gate_back.description: Button that closes the deliberation gate and keeps the session running.

shared_gate_phrase_label.description: Label over the box where the user retypes a phrase to confirm.

shared_gate_end_title.description: Heading of the gate that confirms ending the running session, in the popup and on the block page.

shared_work_choose_tab_error.description: Answer given when the chosen work tab is gone or cannot be used.

shared_work_tab_closed_error.message: That tab is no longer available. Choose another work tab.
shared_work_tab_closed_error.description: Answer given when the chosen work tab has been closed.

shared_work_target_not_saved_error.message: Session started, but the work tab could not be saved. $CHOOSE$
shared_work_target_not_saved_error.description: Shown when a session started but its work tab could not be stored. CHOOSE is the sentence asking the user to pick an available tab.

shared_work_session_changed_error.message: The focus session has changed. Choose your work tab again.
shared_work_session_changed_error.description: Answer given when the work tab was chosen for a session that is no longer running.

shared_work_target_action_stale_error.message: The focus session has changed. Reopen the popup.
shared_work_target_action_stale_error.description: Answer given when a work tab action names a session that is no longer running.
